mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_fine_record (borrow_record_id, user_id, amount, status) VALUES (#{borrowRecordId}, #{userId}, #{amount}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT f.*, b.book_name FROM t_fine_record f LEFT JOIN t_borrow_record br ON f.borrow_record_id = br.id LEFT JOIN t_book b ON br.book_id = b.id WHERE f.id = #{id}

SELECT f.*, b.book_name FROM t_fine_record f LEFT JOIN t_borrow_record br ON f.borrow_record_id = br.id LEFT JOIN t_book b ON br.book_id = b.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.status ASC, f.id DESC

SELECT f.*, b.book_name, u.real_name, u.username FROM t_fine_record f LEFT JOIN t_borrow_record br ON f.borrow_record_id = br.id LEFT JOIN t_book b ON br.book_id = b.id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON f.user_id = u.id
ORDER BY f.status ASC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_fine_record SET status = 1, pay_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0
UPDATE t_fine_record SET status = 1, pay_time = NOW(), operator_id = #{operatorId} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM t_fine_record WHERE status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_fine_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0
